description:
FILED s473w (Opus, 2026-09-09) from the #1502 CPAN-board census.  TWO halves,
and the first is the INSTRUMENT's, which is why it is filed rather than fixed
in the same session that blessed a snapshot with it.

(a) THE BOARD DOES NOT CHDIR TO THE DIST ROOT.  `tools/run-dist-t.pl` runs

        sbcl â¦ --load <generated>.lisp

    from wherever the operator stands, while a real harness (`prove`, `make
    test`) runs a t-file with CWD = the dist root.  A test that uses a RELATIVE
    path therefore fails for a reason that is not PCL's.  MEASURED on
    File-Which t/file_which.t, whose fixtures live in `corpus/`:

        board (no chdir):        13 ok / 6 not ok
        same tree, CWD = dist:   15 ok / 4 not ok
        real perl, CWD = dist:   19 ok / 0 not ok

    So 2 of the 6 rows are the harness's.  Note the ORACLE side already
    chdirs (`cd $dist && perl â¦`), so the board and its oracle have been
    comparing two different setups â the comparison is apples-to-oranges for
    every relative-path test on the board.

    THE FIX IS ONE LINE (`cd \Q$dist\E && sbcl â¦`, matching the oracle), but it
    is a RUNNER change: it moves board verdicts, so it wants its own before/
    after per-file comparison and a re-bless of
    `baselines/cpan-board14-s473w.tsv` + `baselines/cpan-board14-fails.tsv`,
    exactly like the s473 rules require of `tools/sweep-perl-tests.pl`.  Do it
    as its own commit, never folded into a fix batch.

(b) THE OTHER FOUR ROWS ARE REAL, and survive the chdir:

        11  Found test-bin              (a -d check on the win/unix corpus dir)
        12  Found all                   got undef, expected to match "all"
        13  Found at least one result
        15  zero =

    i.e. `File::Which::which` / `where` over a PATH entry the test appends,
    finding nothing where perl finds the corpus executables.  Probe `which`
    against a PATH containing a RELATIVE directory first â that is the shape
    the file sets up (`local $ENV{PATH}` plus `unshift @PATH, $test_bin`) and
    the most likely divergence (a relative PATH entry, or the -x test on it).

REPRODUCE both halves:
    tools/run-dist-t.pl ~/.cpan/build/File-Which-1.27-0 t/file_which.t
    cd ~/.cpan/build/File-Which-1.27-0 && perl -Ilib t/file_which.t     # 19/0
subject: THE BOARD DOES NOT CHDIR to the dist root (its perl oracle does) â measured 2 of File-Which file_which.t 6 failures are the harness; the other 4 are `which` over a relative PATH entry
